quotes.text: physicians identified whether a record was real or synthetic with 53% accuracy, which did not differ from chance (95% bootstrap CI: 43–63%

parsed.rationale: A bootstrap CI is given for the 53% realism headline, with the unit being the 100 physician judgments (and item-level paired deltas in Appendix C.2). The 10-model scores in Table 2 carry no CI or SE, and clustering of tasks within patients is not addressed for them.
